title: SV-12545 - A saved link with a future as-of date opens on that date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • You have the page address of A/P Aging Summary.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Summary" in the left list.
  3. In the browser address bar add ?asOfDate= followed by the last day of next month written YYYY-MM-DD.
  4. Press Enter.
  5. Read the date chip.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • the chip shows the last day of next month and the report is worked out for that date.
  • EXPECT FAIL. What you should see on the upgraded build today: The report opens on today's date instead of the date in the link.
  • (1) You see exactly that: mark the test FAILED and raise nothing new. This is a V1-to-V2 capability loss already reported to the QA lead for a Product Owner decision.
  • (2) It fails in a different way: that is a new problem. Mark FAILED, write down exactly what you saw, and report it.
  • (3) It passes: the capability is back. Mark PASSED and tell the QA lead.
  • Existing ticket: none found (Jira searched 11 Nov 2026).

Why this matters: Links and bookmarks people saved before the release must still open what they showed.

SOURCE: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), app/src/components/ts/reporting/ReportingModel.ts:379; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-receivable/AgingSummaryReport.vue:154-157. V1 code, quoted: `export const isAsOfDate = (value: string): boolean => ISO_DATE.test(value);`

This is the expected behaviour as per the V1 code baseline AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-014) for epic SV-11315; the A/R and A/P Report Sorting PRD v11 (Confluence 947650561) is silent on it. Not yet checked against any build.

AUTOMATION: READY - EXPECT FAIL (the future date in the link is ignored)
